method.approach: radius-only Vehicle C script duplicating only Surveyor's approved sweep method
method.selection_rule: Smallest radius maximizing separation ratio between untrained and best classical success, subject to the 40-70% band and all sanity checks.

adopted.provenance: vehicle-c-sliding-mode-final-attempt: sliding mode stopped after failing to clearly beat this reproduced checkpoint

untrained_baseline.source: Exact existing frozen 9-16-2 tanh network definition and seed 7319 from surveyor-calibration.ts; evaluated on Vehicle C without training.

seed_protocol.reason: Held-out range identical to original calibration and disjoint from all controller-development seeds.

gps_noise_floor.source: Surveyor gps@1.0.0 calibration configuration; no Vehicle-C-specific GPS noise calibration was found.
gps_noise_floor.methodological_note: Terminal hits use simulator truth; this is only a portability sanity check.
